========================================
__has_include with angle and quoted headers
========================================

#if __has_include(<endian.h>)
#endif
#if __has_include("x.h")
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    condition: (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (argument_list (system_lib_string))))
  (preproc_if
    condition: (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (argument_list (string_literal (string_content))))))

========================================
__has_include combined with defined
========================================

#if defined(__has_include) && __has_include(<x.h>)
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    condition: (binary_expression
      left: (preproc_defined (identifier))
      right: (call_expression
        function: (identifier)
        arguments: (argument_list (system_lib_string))))))

========================================
defined without parentheses still parses
========================================

#if defined X
#endif
#ifdef X
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if condition: (preproc_defined (identifier)))
  (preproc_ifdef name: (identifier)))
